heading_path: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.1] Which document wins
text: Heading: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.1] Which document wins ## [KB-00.1] Which document wins When two documents disagree, follow this order of precedence: 1. **Policy documents** (doc_type: policy) with status `current`. 2. **Agent guides** (doc_type: agent_guide). 3. **Help articles** (doc_type: help). 4. **FAQs** (doc_type: faq). 5. **Marketing pages** (doc_type: marketing). These describe benefits in general terms and never override a policy. Documents marked `status: superseded` are kept for reference only. They apply only to the cases their successor document says they still cover.

heading_path: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.2] Today's date
text: Heading: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.2] Today's date ## [KB-00.2] Today's date All records in this dataset are frozen on **20 October 2026**. Treat this date as "today" when you calculate deadlines, delays and refund timelines.

heading_path: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.3] Business days
text: Heading: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.3] Business days ## [KB-00.3] Business days A business day is Monday to Saturday, excluding the warehouse holidays below. Refund and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days. | Date | Holiday | | --- | --- | | 2026-08-15 | Independence Day | | 2026-10-02 | Gandhi Jayanti | | 2026-10-19 | Warehouse closure (festival) | | 2026-11-09 | Warehouse closure (festival) |

heading_path: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.4] Document list
text: Heading: About this knowledge base > [KB-00.4] Document list ## [KB-00.4] Document list See the file names in this folder. Policy documents start with `pol_`, agent guides with `agent_`, help articles with `help_`, FAQs with `faq_`, and marketing pages with `mkt_`.

heading_path: Conversation style > [STY-1] Opening
text: Heading: Conversation style > [STY-1] Opening Context: Customers reach ZentroMart support by chat, email, support ticket and voice message. These rules apply on every channel. ## [STY-1] Opening Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.

heading_path: Conversation style > [STY-2] Written replies
text: Heading: Conversation style > [STY-2] Written replies Context: Customers reach ZentroMart support by chat, email, support ticket and voice message. These rules apply on every channel. ## [STY-2] Written replies Keep chat replies to two or three short sentences. In emails and tickets, start with a greeting, answer the question first, and end with a sign-off. Write dates with the month name ("24 October").

heading_path: Conversation style > [STY-3] Voice replies
text: Heading: Conversation style > [STY-3] Voice replies Context: Customers reach ZentroMart support by chat, email, support ticket and voice message. These rules apply on every channel. ## [STY-3] Voice replies When replying by voice, keep it to two or three short sentences. Say dates with the month name ("the 24th of October"), read order IDs in groups of four digits, and say amounts in rupees ("forty-nine rupees").

heading_path: Conversation style > [STY-4] Language
text: Heading: Conversation style > [STY-4] Language Context: Customers reach ZentroMart support by chat, email, support ticket and voice message. These rules apply on every channel. ## [STY-4] Language Reply in the language the customer uses. If the customer switches language, switch with them.

heading_path: Conversation style > [STY-5] One question at a time
text: Heading: Conversation style > [STY-5] One question at a time Context: Customers reach ZentroMart support by chat, email, support ticket and voice message. These rules apply on every channel. ## [STY-5] One question at a time When you need details, ask for one thing at a time.

heading_path: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human
text: Heading: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human ## [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human Hand over at once when any of these is true: 1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.** 2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.** 3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.** 4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.** 5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.** 6. **Customer asks for a human agent.** 7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.** For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

heading_path: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-2] What to do first
text: Heading: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-2] What to do first ## [ESC-2] What to do first Create a ticket with `create_ticket` before handing over. Tell the customer a human colleague will contact them, and never promise an outcome, amount or time beyond what a policy states.

heading_path: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-3] Handover summary
text: Heading: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-3] Handover summary ## [ESC-3] Handover summary The ticket summary must contain: the customer's issue, the detected intent, the order ID if any, what the customer has already told you, what you already checked, and the reason for escalation.

heading_path: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-4] Things you must never do
text: Heading: Escalation and human handover > [ESC-4] Things you must never do ## [ESC-4] Things you must never do - Promise compensation, refunds or exceptions that a policy does not allow. - Say an action is done unless the tool call succeeded. - Share another customer's details.

heading_path: Verifying the customer > [IDV-1] When verification is needed
text: Heading: Verifying the customer > [IDV-1] When verification is needed ## [IDV-1] When verification is needed Before sharing anything about a specific order (status, items, address, amounts, refund details), verify the customer. General policy questions need no verification.

heading_path: Verifying the customer > [IDV-2] How to verify
text: Heading: Verifying the customer > [IDV-2] How to verify ## [IDV-2] How to verify Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.

heading_path: Verifying the customer > [IDV-3] If verification fails
text: Heading: Verifying the customer > [IDV-3] If verification fails ## [IDV-3] If verification fails Allow one retry. If it fails again, do not share order details. Offer general policy help and suggest the customer contact support from the registered phone number.

heading_path: Verifying the customer > [IDV-4] Never read out
text: Heading: Verifying the customer > [IDV-4] Never read out ## [IDV-4] Never read out Never read out the full phone number, email or street address, even to a verified customer.

heading_path: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-1] How long do refunds take?
text: Heading: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-1] How long do refunds take? ## [FAQ-1] How long do refunds take? Refunds usually take 5 to 7 days to reach your account.

heading_path: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-2] Can I return something I bought?
text: Heading: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-2] Can I return something I bought? ## [FAQ-2] Can I return something I bought? Most items can be returned within the return window. Some items, like grocery, cannot be returned.

heading_path: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-3] Is delivery free?
text: Heading: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-3] Is delivery free? ## [FAQ-3] Is delivery free? Delivery is free on most orders.

heading_path: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-4] Can I talk to a person?
text: Heading: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-4] Can I talk to a person? ## [FAQ-4] Can I talk to a person? Yes. Ask the assistant to connect you to a human colleague.

heading_path: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-5] Do you deliver outside India?
text: Heading: Frequently asked questions > [FAQ-5] Do you deliver outside India? ## [FAQ-5] Do you deliver outside India? We currently deliver only within India.

heading_path: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-1] क्या मैं ऑर्डर कैंसिल कर सकता हूँ?
text: Heading: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-1] क्या मैं ऑर्डर कैंसिल कर सकता हूँ? ## [FAQH-1] क्या मैं ऑर्डर कैंसिल कर सकता हूँ? हाँ, ऑर्डर शिप होने से पहले आप उसे मुफ़्त में कैंसिल कर सकते हैं। शिप होने के बाद ऑर्डर कैंसिल नहीं होता, लेकिन आप डिलीवरी के समय पार्सल लेने से मना कर सकते हैं।

heading_path: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-2] कैश ऑन डिलीवरी का रिफ़ंड कैसे मिलेगा?
text: Heading: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-2] कैश ऑन डिलीवरी का रिफ़ंड कैसे मिलेगा? ## [FAQH-2] कैश ऑन डिलीवरी का रिफ़ंड कैसे मिलेगा? आप ZentroMart Wallet में तुरंत रिफ़ंड ले सकते हैं, या बैंक ट्रांसफ़र चुन सकते हैं। बैंक ट्रांसफ़र में बैंक डिटेल्स वेरिफ़ाई होने के बाद 5 से 7 कामकाजी दिन लगते हैं।

heading_path: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-3] खराब या गलत सामान आया तो क्या करें?
text: Heading: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-3] खराब या गलत सामान आया तो क्या करें? ## [FAQH-3] खराब या गलत सामान आया तो क्या करें? डिलीवरी के 48 घंटे के अंदर सामान और पैकेट की फ़ोटो के साथ शिकायत करें। जाँच के बाद मुफ़्त रिप्लेसमेंट या पूरा रिफ़ंड मिलेगा।

heading_path: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-4] ZentroMart Plus में क्या मिलता है?
text: Heading: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल > [FAQH-4] ZentroMart Plus में क्या मिलता है? ## [FAQH-4] ZentroMart Plus में क्या मिलता है? मुफ़्त एक्सप्रेस डिलीवरी, किसी भी रिटर्न पर पिकअप फ़ीस नहीं, और रिटर्न का रिफ़ंड पिकअप के समय ही शुरू हो जाता है।

heading_path: Reverse pickup: how it works > [RVP-1] Booking
text: Heading: Reverse pickup: how it works > [RVP-1] Booking ## [RVP-1] Booking Raise the return from My Orders. Choose a pickup slot. The delivery executive will check the item at the door against the condition rules in RET-4.

heading_path: Reverse pickup: how it works > [RVP-2] Missed pickup
text: Heading: Reverse pickup: how it works > [RVP-2] Missed pickup ## [RVP-2] Missed pickup If the executive does not arrive, the pickup is rescheduled automatically to the next business day. After two missed pickups, the customer can ask support to raise a priority pickup.

heading_path: Reverse pickup: how it works > [RVP-3] Item rejected at the door
text: Heading: Reverse pickup: how it works > [RVP-3] Item rejected at the door ## [RVP-3] Item rejected at the door If the item fails the doorstep check, the executive will not collect it, and the customer gets an SMS with the reason.

heading_path: Tracking your order > [TRK-1] Order statuses
text: Heading: Tracking your order > [TRK-1] Order statuses ## [TRK-1] Order statuses | Status shown | What it means | | --- | --- | | Placed | Payment confirmed, waiting to be packed | | Packed | Packed at the warehouse, waiting for courier pickup | | Shipped | With the courier, on the way | | Out for delivery | With the delivery executive today | | Delivery attempted | The courier could not deliver; see DEL-3 | | Delivered | Handed over at the address | | Returned to origin (RTO) | Could not be delivered and is going back to the warehouse; prepaid refunds follow REF-1 | | Cancelled | Cancelled before shipping |

heading_path: Tracking your order > [TRK-2] Delivered but not received
text: Heading: Tracking your order > [TRK-2] Delivered but not received ## [TRK-2] Delivered but not received If an order shows Delivered but the customer has not received it, check with family, neighbours or the building security, then report it within 48 hours as a missing item under DWM-1.

heading_path: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-1] Wireless earbuds: one side not working
text: Heading: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-1] Wireless earbuds: one side not working Context: Try these steps before raising a return or warranty claim. ## [TRB-1] Wireless earbuds: one side not working 1. Put both earbuds in the case and close the lid for 10 seconds. 2. Remove the earbuds from the phone's Bluetooth list ("forget device"). 3. Hold the case button for 15 seconds until the light flashes, then pair again.

heading_path: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-2] Smartwatch not syncing
text: Heading: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-2] Smartwatch not syncing Context: Try these steps before raising a return or warranty claim. ## [TRB-2] Smartwatch not syncing 1. Make sure the companion app has Bluetooth and location permission. 2. Restart the watch and the phone. 3. Unpair the watch in the app and pair it again.

heading_path: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-3] Phone charging slowly
text: Heading: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-3] Phone charging slowly Context: Try these steps before raising a return or warranty claim. ## [TRB-3] Phone charging slowly 1. Use the original cable and adapter. 2. Clean the charging port gently with a dry, soft brush. 3. Turn on airplane mode while charging to check whether background apps are the cause.

heading_path: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-4] Bluetooth speaker not powering on
text: Heading: Troubleshooting common electronics issues > [TRB-4] Bluetooth speaker not powering on Context: Try these steps before raising a return or warranty claim. ## [TRB-4] Bluetooth speaker not powering on 1. Charge it for at least 30 minutes with the original cable. 2. Hold the power button for 10 seconds to force a restart. If the problem continues after these steps, the item can be returned within its window or claimed under warranty.

heading_path: Why join ZentroMart Plus > [MKT-1] Shop more, worry less
text: Heading: Why join ZentroMart Plus > [MKT-1] Shop more, worry less ## [MKT-1] Shop more, worry less Lightning-fast delivery, hassle-free returns and money back faster than ever. Join ZentroMart Plus for just ₹999 a year.

heading_path: Cancellations policy > [CAN-1] Before the order ships
text: Heading: Cancellations policy > [CAN-1] Before the order ships ## [CAN-1] Before the order ships Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately.

heading_path: Cancellations policy > [CAN-2] After the order ships
text: Heading: Cancellations policy > [CAN-2] After the order ships ## [CAN-2] After the order ships A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can: - refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or - accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.

heading_path: Cancellations policy > [CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots
text: Heading: Cancellations policy > [CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots ## [CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots Grocery orders can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the start of the chosen delivery slot. If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed.

heading_path: Cancellations policy > [CAN-4] Partial cancellation
text: Heading: Cancellations policy > [CAN-4] Partial cancellation ## [CAN-4] Partial cancellation Individual items in a multi-item order can be cancelled before they ship. Coupon rules in REF-4 apply.

heading_path: Coupons and offers > [CPN-1] One coupon per order
text: Heading: Coupons and offers > [CPN-1] One coupon per order ## [CPN-1] One coupon per order Only 1 coupon can be applied per order. Coupons cannot be combined, added after the order is placed, or exchanged for cash.

heading_path: Coupons and offers > [CPN-2] Expired or failed coupons
text: Heading: Coupons and offers > [CPN-2] Expired or failed coupons ## [CPN-2] Expired or failed coupons A coupon that was valid but failed to apply because of a technical error can be re-issued once by support if the order was placed within the coupon's validity. Coupons that had already expired cannot be re-issued.

heading_path: Coupons and offers > [CPN-3] Returns and coupons
text: Heading: Coupons and offers > [CPN-3] Returns and coupons ## [CPN-3] Returns and coupons See REF-4 in the Refunds policy.

heading_path: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-1] Reporting window
text: Heading: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-1] Reporting window ## [DWM-1] Reporting window Report a damaged, defective, expired, wrong or missing item within **48 hours of delivery**, with photos of the item and the packaging. This applies to every category, including grocery and other non-returnable items.

heading_path: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-2] Resolution
text: Heading: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-2] Resolution ## [DWM-2] Resolution After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies.

heading_path: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-3] High-value items
text: Heading: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-3] High-value items ## [DWM-3] High-value items Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims.

heading_path: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-4] Reported after 48 hours
text: Heading: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-4] Reported after 48 hours ## [DWM-4] Reported after 48 hours Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.

heading_path: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-5] Safety issues
text: Heading: Damaged, wrong or missing items > [DWM-5] Safety issues ## [DWM-5] Safety issues If a product shows a safety risk, such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or heat, the customer must stop using it immediately. The agent must hand over to a human at once.

heading_path: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-1] Delivery times
text: Heading: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-1] Delivery times ## [DEL-1] Delivery times | Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations | | --- | --- | --- | | Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days | | Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available | Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.

heading_path: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-2] Delivery fees
text: Heading: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-2] Delivery fees ## [DEL-2] Delivery fees Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members.

heading_path: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-3] Delivery attempts
text: Heading: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-3] Delivery attempts ## [DEL-3] Delivery attempts The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies.

heading_path: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-4] Late deliveries
text: Heading: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-4] Late deliveries ## [DEL-4] Late deliveries If an **Express** order arrives after its promised date, the ₹79 express fee the customer paid is credited to ZentroMart Wallet automatically within 48 hours. ZentroMart Plus members, who pay no express fee, get no credit. There is no compensation for late Standard deliveries. Agents must not offer any other compensation.

heading_path: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-5] Where we deliver
text: Heading: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-5] Where we deliver ## [DEL-5] Where we deliver ZentroMart delivers only within India, to pincodes listed as serviceable in the pincode table. Cash on delivery and Express are available only where the pincode table says so (`cod_available`, `express_available`). Not every metro pincode has Express.

heading_path: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-6] Changing the address
text: Heading: Delivery and shipping policy > [DEL-6] Changing the address ## [DEL-6] Changing the address The delivery address can be changed before the order ships. After shipping, the address cannot be changed.

heading_path: Marketplace sellers > [MKS-1] Who ships your order
text: Heading: Marketplace sellers > [MKS-1] Who ships your order ## [MKS-1] Who ships your order Each product in the catalog has a `fulfilled_by` field. Items are either fulfilled by ZentroMart or by an independent marketplace seller.

heading_path: Marketplace sellers > [MKS-2] Returns and refunds
text: Heading: Marketplace sellers > [MKS-2] Returns and refunds ## [MKS-2] Returns and refunds Return windows, reverse pickup and refunds are the same for every seller and are handled by ZentroMart.

heading_path: Marketplace sellers > [MKS-3] Warranty
text: Heading: Marketplace sellers > [MKS-3] Warranty ## [MKS-3] Warranty ZentroMart Assured never applies to marketplace seller items, even if the listing says assured. Seller items carry only the brand warranty.

heading_path: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-1] Payment methods
text: Heading: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-1] Payment methods ## [PAY-1] Payment methods UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, ZentroMart Wallet and cash on delivery (COD).

heading_path: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-2] Cash on delivery
text: Heading: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-2] Cash on delivery ## [PAY-2] Cash on delivery COD is available on orders up to ₹10,000, only on pincodes where COD is enabled. A COD fee of ₹25 applies per order.

heading_path: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-3] Failed payments
text: Heading: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-3] Failed payments ## [PAY-3] Failed payments If money was deducted but the order was not placed, the amount is reversed automatically by the payment provider within 5 business days. No ticket is needed before that.

heading_path: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-4] ZentroMart Wallet
text: Heading: Payments and cash on delivery > [PAY-4] ZentroMart Wallet ## [PAY-4] ZentroMart Wallet ZentroMart Wallet balance can be used on any order and never expires. It cannot be transferred to a bank account. For cash-on-delivery refunds, the customer chooses Wallet or bank transfer before the refund is made (REF-3); once refunded to the Wallet, it stays there.

heading_path: ZentroMart Plus membership > [PLS-1] Price
text: Heading: ZentroMart Plus membership > [PLS-1] Price ## [PLS-1] Price ZentroMart Plus costs ₹999 a year.

heading_path: ZentroMart Plus membership > [PLS-2] Benefits
text: Heading: ZentroMart Plus membership > [PLS-2] Benefits ## [PLS-2] Benefits - Free Express delivery where Express is available. - No reverse pickup fee on any return. - Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check. ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.

heading_path: ZentroMart Plus membership > [PLS-3] Cancelling membership
text: Heading: ZentroMart Plus membership > [PLS-3] Cancelling membership ## [PLS-3] Cancelling membership Membership can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund if no benefit has been used.

heading_path: Refunds policy > [REF-1] When a refund is initiated
text: Heading: Refunds policy > [REF-1] When a refund is initiated ## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated - **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation. - **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup. - **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.

heading_path: Refunds policy > [REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation
text: Heading: Refunds policy > [REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation ## [REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation Refunds go back to the original payment method. Timelines are counted in business days from the day the refund is initiated. | Payment method | Time to reach you | | --- | --- | | UPI | 1 to 3 business days | | Credit or debit card | 5 to 7 business days | | Net banking | 3 to 5 business days | | ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours | | Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7 business days | | ZentroMart Wallet for cash-on-delivery orders | Instant, within 2 hours |

heading_path: Refunds policy > [REF-3] Cash-on-delivery refunds
text: Heading: Refunds policy > [REF-3] Cash-on-delivery refunds ## [REF-3] Cash-on-delivery refunds For cash-on-delivery orders, the customer chooses either ZentroMart Wallet (instant) or a bank transfer. Bank transfers start only after the bank account details are verified, then take 5 to 7 business days.

heading_path: Refunds policy > [REF-4] Partial refunds and coupons
text: Heading: Refunds policy > [REF-4] Partial refunds and coupons ## [REF-4] Partial refunds and coupons If part of an order is returned, the refund is the price paid for that item after its share of any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items is deducted from the refund.

heading_path: Refunds policy > [REF-5] Delivery and COD fees
text: Heading: Refunds policy > [REF-5] Delivery and COD fees ## [REF-5] Delivery and COD fees Delivery fees and the ₹25 cash-on-delivery fee are refunded only when the whole order is cancelled before shipping or returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

heading_path: Refunds policy > [REF-6] Refund reference number
text: Heading: Refunds policy > [REF-6] Refund reference number ## [REF-6] Refund reference number Every initiated refund has a refund reference number (RRN) that the customer's bank can trace. Share it when a customer says the money has not arrived.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 3) > [RETv3-2] Return windows by category
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 3) > [RETv3-2] Return windows by category Context: This version was replaced by version 4 on 1 August 2026. It still applies only to electronics delivered before 1 August 2026. ## [RETv3-2] Return windows by category | Category | Return window | | --- | --- | | Electronics and accessories | 10 days | | Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | | Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | | Beauty and personal care (unopened) | 7 days | | Books and stationery | 10 days | | Grocery, innerwear, gift cards | Not returnable |

heading_path: Returns policy (version 3) > [RETv3-6] Reverse pickup
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 3) > [RETv3-6] Reverse pickup Context: This version was replaced by version 4 on 1 August 2026. It still applies only to electronics delivered before 1 August 2026. ## [RETv3-6] Reverse pickup Reverse pickup is free for all returns.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-1] Scope
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-1] Scope ## [RET-1] Scope This policy covers items bought on ZentroMart, whether shipped by ZentroMart or by a marketplace seller. Seller-specific warranty terms are in the Marketplace sellers policy, but return windows are the same for every seller.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-2] Return windows by category
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-2] Return windows by category ## [RET-2] Return windows by category The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog. | Category | Return window | Catalog code | | --- | --- | --- | | Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` | | Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` | | Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` | | Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` | | Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` | | Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` | | Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` | | Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-3] Change to electronics returns
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-3] Change to electronics returns ## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-4] Condition of returned items
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-4] Condition of returned items ## [RET-4] Condition of returned items Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-5] Items that cannot be returned
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-5] Items that cannot be returned ## [RET-5] Items that cannot be returned Grocery and fresh produce, innerwear, lingerie and swimwear, and gift cards or digital codes cannot be returned for change of mind. If such an item arrives damaged, expired, wrong or missing, follow the Damaged, wrong or missing items policy.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees ## [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-7] After pickup
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-7] After pickup ## [RET-7] After pickup Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-8] Festive sale returns
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-8] Festive sale returns ## [RET-8] Festive sale returns Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2.

heading_path: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-9] Exchanges
text: Heading: Returns policy (version 4) > [RET-9] Exchanges ## [RET-9] Exchanges Exchanges for a different size or colour are available on clothing and footwear within the return window, subject to stock. If the new size is out of stock, a return and refund is offered instead.

heading_path: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured > [WAR-1] Brand warranty
text: Heading: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured > [WAR-1] Brand warranty ## [WAR-1] Brand warranty Most electronics come with the manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is listed in the `warranty_months` column of the product catalog. Brand warranty claims are made with the manufacturer's service centre.

heading_path: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured > [WAR-2] ZentroMart Assured
text: Heading: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured > [WAR-2] ZentroMart Assured ## [WAR-2] ZentroMart Assured Products marked `assured = true` in the catalog carry a 12-month ZentroMart Assured warranty from the delivery date, in addition to any brand warranty. Claims are raised in the app under My Orders, and ZentroMart arranges pickup and repair or replacement.

heading_path: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured > [WAR-3] What warranty does not cover
text: Heading: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured > [WAR-3] What warranty does not cover ## [WAR-3] What warranty does not cover Physical damage, liquid damage, normal wear and unauthorised repairs are not covered.
